title: Refund and dispute policy
description: How Farmkeke protects your payment, what happens if a farm doesn't accept, how to report a problem, and how refunds are paid.
short: **In short:** Farmkeke holds your payment until you confirm your order. If something goes wrong, report it before confirming, and we'll make it right.

blocks.p: When you pay for an order, Farmkeke holds the money. The farm is paid only after you confirm that your order arrived as expected, or after a problem report is resolved.
You can confirm receipt only once your order is marked delivered or collected. Pickup orders wait at the farm for 3 days once they are ready.

sections.title: If the farm does not accept

blocks.p: Each farm has 24 hours to accept your order. If the farm declines or does not respond in time, the order is cancelled and anything you paid for it is refunded in full, including any delivery fee.

Home delivery orders are paid only after the farm accepts and the delivery is priced, so you pay nothing for a delivery order the farm declines. If you do not pay your delivery bill within 12 hours, the order is cancelled and you are not charged.
If your order is missing, damaged, incomplete, wrong, short or not as described, report it from your order page **before** you confirm receipt. Please include:

ul: which items were affected, and how many
a short description of what went wrong

blocks.p: Your payment stays held while we look into it. Once you confirm receipt, the payment is released and the order can no longer be disputed through Farmkeke.
If you do not confirm or report a problem within 24 hours of delivery, we remind you, and our team may release the payment to the farm after checking the delivery records.

The farm has 12 hours to reply to your report. Farmkeke then reviews the photos, messages and delivery records, and usually makes a decision within one day. We tell you the outcome by email and in the app. If you disagree, contact support and we will look at it again.

ul: **Full refund**, including the delivery fee, if the whole order is affected, or the farm does not accept it.
**Part refund** for the affected items only. The rest of the payment is released to the farm.
The delivery fee is not refunded for a part refund, because the delivery took place.

blocks.p: If you cannot collect a pickup order within 3 days, contact support as soon as possible. We will work with the farm to arrange a later collection or, where the produce can no longer be collected, decide on a refund.

Refunds go back to the card or bank account you paid with, through Paystack. Your bank may take up to 7 working days to show the refund. You can track it on your order page using the refund reference.
Only payments made through Farmkeke are protected. If a farmer asks you to pay them directly or in cash, please refuse and report it to [support@farmkeke.com](mailto:support@farmkeke.com).
This policy does not affect your rights under the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2018. You can also contact the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Commission (FCCPC).
